SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LTAL') ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER ,A.PO_NO ,A.PO_SEQ ,A.STATUS ,A.PLANT ,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,A.DESCRIPTION ,A.SPECIFICATION ,A.UNIT_MEASURE ,A.UNIT_PRICE ,A.ITEM_QTY ,A.ITEM_AMT ,A.RD_DATE ,A.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_DATE ,A.ADD_USER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID ,A.ADD_USER_DEPT AS REQ_USER_DEPT ,A.KEY_1 AS REQ_USER_NAME ,A.DELY_TO_LOCATION ,A.REF_PR_NO ,A.LEGACY_PO_NO ,A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ ,'N' AS IF_FLAG ,'N' AS REG_FLAG ,A.REMARK FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND A.STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
